analysis.title: Playful Desktop Collage Landing Page
analysis.notes: A bright landing page uses a spacious off-white canvas as a desktop-like stage for overlapping media windows, playful doodles, and a large central headline. Blue and peach controls, nostalgic image treatments, and varied window scales create an approachable collage with strong visual motion.
analysis.heroPrompt: Wide landing-page hero visual showing a cheerful person standing in a brightly stocked convenience-store aisle, framed symmetrically between colorful shelves. Use a slightly soft vintage camcorder look, subtle motion blur, muted saturated colors, natural fluorescent lighting, and a centered figure with generous negative space around the image. Present it as a large rounded-corner media panel with a translucent pill-shaped play control overlaid near the lower center; no logos, readable signage, or branded products.
